---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new Snowflake or Cortex AI tool or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A concise description of the feature or enhancement.

## Use Case

Describe the problem this would solve or the workflow it would enable in Snowflake.

## Proposed Solution

How you envision this working. For new tools, include:

- Snowflake SQL / Cortex API feature involved
- Proposed tool name (e.g., `snowflake_...` or `cortex_...`)
- Parameters and expected return value
- Safety annotations (e.g., read-only vs mutation)

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've considered and why they're less ideal.

## Additional Context

Links to Snowflake docs, related issues, or examples.
